label: Adjust Buckle
note: Owner-uploaded reference images. Authoritative for construction/appearance; NOT usable as the tech-pack illustration (not line art, or shows multiple options).

references.evidence: Real photograph. The adjuster is a METAL BUCKLE with a strap tab, not a button adjuster, and there is no belt loop beside it - the two discriminators that separate this option from its siblings 'Square Side Adjust Button' (adjuster-left) and 'Adjustable Buckle with Belt Loop' (adjuster-buckle-loop). It sits on the waistband set back from the extension buttons, consistent with a rear-of-side-seam placement.

Real photograph, the widest and clearest view in this set. Zooming the full waistband strip confirms a metal buckle adjuster with strap tab and no belt loop anywhere along the band, which distinguishes this option from adjuster-buckle-loop, and confirms buckle rather than square-button hardware, which distinguishes it from adjuster-left. The adjuster sits clearly rearward of the centre-front extension buttons.

Real photograph and the sharpest hardware detail of the four. Unmistakably a metal buckle adjuster (brass, twin-bar, rectangular frame) with a pointed strap tab - buckle hardware, not a square button, and no adjacent belt loop, matching this option and excluding both siblings.

Real photograph of real cloth, with an overlaid title - the pixels of the garment are photographic, not a UI capture, so I classify it photograph rather than screenshot. It shows a metal buckle side adjuster with strap tab on a trouser waistband, no belt loop beside it, so the hardware type matches this option.
